correctness.rationale: All 60 canonical hexagons and exactly 20 Steiner/60 Kirkman concurrence triples are constructed by two independent finite descriptions. Their equality holds for all 720 label permutations of source examples. An exact rational specialization demonstrates 60 distinct Pascal lines and 80 distinct concurrence points. The 60-by-60 graph is connected and degree eight; exact Bareiss determinant and local Smith counts at primes 2,3,5,11 agree at three deleted roots. The 59 factors, including units, account for the full spanning-tree order, so no unverified prime or torsion is omitted.

value.rationale: Taking all Steiner and Kirkman triple concurrences is a canonically motivated structure, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The new integral graph invariant refines the known six Desargues-sector decomposition, with Steiner triangles joining sectors. Its mixed 2,3,5,11 torsion and exponent 5280 are nontrivial exact structural information not implied by the spectrum or by Frobenius flag counts. No general downstream geometry is claimed.
